subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No diff exists between the AI-AMSD-2041 branch and develop — the branch contains zero implementation changes. The prescribed minimal fix (replacing useMemo with useState + useEffect subscribing to Stack.livePreview.onContentUpdate) has not been applied. The ContentstackProvider still freezes content at build-time, making live preview impossible.
issues.suggestedFix: Apply the prescribed minimal fix: change `const context = useMemo(() => ({ content: defaultContent }), [defaultContent])` to `const [content, setContent] = useState(defaultContent)` and add a useEffect that calls `Stack.livePreview.onContentUpdate((updatedContent) => setContent(prev => ({ ...prev, ...updatedContent })))`. The context value becomes `{ content }` from state.

issues.description: The includeDraft flag is not propagated through the public-facing contentstack service functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getSingletonEntry). Per learned review rules, draft content will never be served because no caller passes includeDraft: true to the factory. Without this, activating preview mode cannot display draft CMS content — the first acceptance criterion is unmet.
issues.suggestedFix: Add includeDraft to IContentstackGetEntry, IContentstackGetSingleEntry, IContentstackGetSingletonEntry interfaces, accept the parameter in the public functions, and propagate it to ContentstackFactory. Page-level getStaticProps must read context.preview and pass includeDraft: true when in preview mode.

issues.description: No livePreview callback registration exists anywhere in the codebase. The provider may expose setContent via useState, but nothing registers Stack.livePreview.onContentUpdate to actually call it. Without this registration, setContent is never invoked, the context never updates, and all live preview acceptance criteria are unmet.
issues.suggestedFix: Register the Contentstack Live Preview SDK callback at the app bootstrap level (e.g., _app.tsx or equivalent) so that onContentUpdate calls setContent with the updated content object.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests were added for the live preview / includeDraft functionality. Per review criteria, new features must have corresponding vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ path. There are zero tests verifying that setContent updates the context value and triggers re-renders, that the initial state matches defaultContent, or that includeDraft: true causes addParam('include_draft', 'true') to be called.
issues.suggestedFix: Add vitest unit tests mirroring src/ paths: test/unit/context/ContentstackContext.test.tsx verifying initial state, setContent updates, and consumer re-renders; test/unit/services/contentstack/*.test.ts verifying includeDraft propagation to the factory and addParam calls.
